_comment: LLM judge for gb-2019-system-response (python -m environment.incident.judge run <episode_dir> --config configs/judge.example.json). The API key is never in this file: export OPENROUTER_API_KEY. Keys starting with '_' are comments.
_temperature: sent only where the model lists it on OpenRouter (openai/gpt-6.1-sol does not: it is a reasoning model); the run records temperature_sent per request
_prices: used only when OpenRouter reports no cost for a request (decision 25: about $2 / $10 per million tokens)
_modes: auto_numeric criteria are never sent; auto_assisted_human proposals are recorded for the reviewer and ignored by the merge
